Hi,

Find the below JD for AI Engineer with data bricks




Exp: 9+years

Location: Pan India

Notice period: Immediate to 30days




JD

Strong hands-on experience building Databricks Apps using Python, SQL, Streamlit, Flask, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Databricks Genie Code, coding agents, and AI-assisted development tools.
Strong knowledge of Mosaic AI, AI Playground, Foundation Model APIs, and Model Serving.
Experience building RAG solutions, AI agents, tool-calling workflows, and multi-agent applications.
Hands-on experience with Vector Search, embeddings, chunking, retrieval, and prompt engineering.
Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and Lakehouse architecture.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, logging, and production deployment.
Understanding of AI security, access controls, secrets management, data governance, and responsible AI.
Must be a hands-on builder who can independently design, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications.
